title: Pure Hecahands
summary: Hecahands cards with generic staples; the page's Chimera, Azamina and Relinquished hybrids are left out. The Level 7 Hecahands summon themselves whenever the opponent adds a card to their hand, then steal monsters from the opponent's hand, Deck top or GY, and none of them can be destroyed in battle. Ibtel and Yadel shuffle themselves back to summon or search, and the Counter Traps take the negated card for you. The Blazing Dominion cards lead: Mankibuel Fusion Summons from the hand, Dandalos steals a monster every turn, and Hecahands Bait trades a Tribute for one of theirs. The page calls Mankibuel "Makibel"; the TCG name is used here.
main: Hecahands Ibtel
Reveals and shuffles itself back to summon a Hecahands from the Deck; from the GY, revives one.
Hecahands Yadel
Reveals and shuffles itself back to search a Hecahands Spell/Trap; from the GY, Sets one.
Hecahands Breus
Summons itself when they add to their hand; summons a monster from their hand.
Hecahands Gaigas
Summons itself when they add to their hand; excavates three of their Deck to take a monster.
Hecahands Godos
Summons itself when they add to their hand; takes a monster from their GY on their turn.
Hecahands Mankibuel
2026 support. Reveals itself to Fusion Summon a Hecahands Fusion from the hand; returns from the GY.
The Hidden Hecahands
Searches a Hecahands monster and Sets a Hecahands Spell/Trap; from the GY, makes them draw and discard.
Hecahands Tartaros
Quick-Play: bounces a Spell/Trap, or Fusion Summons from the GY using their monsters.
Ib'al-Hecahands
Counter Trap: negates a monster effect, destroys it and summons it for you.
Yad'al-Hecahands
Counter Trap: negates a Spell/Trap, destroys it and Sets it for you.
Hecahands Bait
2026 support. Tributes a Hecahands or a stolen monster to take one of theirs.
extra: 2026 support. Two Hecahands: takes a monster every turn; your Fusions and stolen monsters attack directly.
Hecahands + Illusion, or Tribute a stolen monster: searches a Hecahands card each turn.
Three Hecahands: summons a card from their Extra Deck; destroyed, steals their monsters.
